reason: 该插件的核心用途是为仅监听本机的 dsh Web UI 增加一个外部访问入口：先通过登录门禁，再将请求完整反向代理到本地后端，用户可通过配置主机端口进行访问。其主要能力集中在网络接入控制与鉴权，不是代码生成、测试框架或数据分析类功能。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 dsh 插件，在不修改 dsh 核心的情况下，为本机监听的 dsh Web UI 提供可配置的外部访问入口，先完成登录验证再反向代理到本地服务。
summaries.en: This is a dsh plugin that adds a configurable external entry for a local dsh Web UI, requiring login before proxying traffic to the local backend.

capabilities: HTTP/WS reverse proxying from external host/port to local dsh UI
Login/setup rate limiting and lockout controls

reasons.code: README documents an external listener (default 0.0.0.0:3081) that fronts dsh and forwards verified traffic to 127.0.0.1:3080 via reverse proxy for both HTTP and WebSocket paths.
The plugin exposes setup and login endpoints with username/password flow, session cookie behavior (`dsh_gw_session`), and login/setup attempt limits (e.g., maxLoginAttempts, lock durations).
Configuration and directory entries show runtime-local storage paths for users and setup tokens, indicating on-disk credential/token persistence and local state files.
Repository structure includes dedicated modules for auth, proxying, and user-store logic, confirming implemented auth and network mediation capabilities.

capabilities: HTTP/WS reverse proxying from external host/port to local dsh UI
Login/setup rate limiting and lockout controls
